text: michelle: quick design review request — iterating on the playground chat UI. main things: streaming display (live token flow), stop/regenerate affordance, where to put the token counter, and prompt library quick-insert. dropping mocks and options below, please chime with accessibility nits and copy. sam: skimmed — looks great overall. one quick ask: can we make the stop control always visible when streaming? users expect an explicit affordance. :eyes: jorge: +1 on visible stop, but worried about clutter in compact layout. could we collapse it into a single compact icon that expands on hover/focus? alex: for compact we explored two options in the mock: 1) inline trailing controls (icon cluster after the last token), 2) persistent footer toolbar with retry/stop/regenerate grouped. attached is a tiny ascii mock: ``` [Chat bubble] Hello, here's the streaming text... ◦ ◦ | [⏹] [↻] [⚙] ----------------------------------------------- | Token counter: 124 | Prompt: My search -> [insert] ``` alex: inline controls keep context but are touch-awkward on mobile. footer toolbar is discoverable but steals vertical space. katie: accessibility: keyboard focus order matters — if stop is inline, ensure it is reachable via tab right after the message content. aria-label should be explicit like `aria-label=\"Stop streaming response\"`. screen reader should announce when streaming starts/stops. michelle: good note — change microcopy from just `Stop` to `Stop streaming` for clarity. also flag that `Regenerate` should be separated from `Retry` (retry = re-run same request with identical prompt, regenerate = new sampling). jorge: token counter position thoughts: show per-response token count vs cumulative session tokens? my vote: per-response by default, with a tooltip to surface session totals. less noisy that way. sam: can we make the token counter collapse to an icon-only view in compact mode, with a hover/tap reveal? small icon with badge number. alex: UX for prompt library quick-insert — two modes: inline insert (paste prompt into composer) vs canned send (insert+send). default to insert so user can edit. offer a small lightning icon to `insert+run` for power users. katie: accessibility for prompt insert: ensure the dialog is modal and focus is trapped, with `role=dialog` and `aria-modal=true`. keyboard shortcut to open prompt library: `Ctrl+K` (or Cmd+K on mac). announce chosen prompt on selection. michelle: copy tweaks — suggestion: `Stop streaming` / `Regenerate response` / `Retry` / token counter label `tokens (response)` — keep labels short. Also propose microcopy for prompt library: `Insert and edit` and `Insert & send` for the two actions. alex: quick code suggestion for SR labels: ``` tokens: 128 ``` alex: also we should emit an accessibility announcement when streaming finishes: `notify('Streaming complete, 128 tokens')` — screen reader will pick this up. sam: telemetry ask: track which affordance people use (inline stop vs footer) and how often `insert+run` is used from prompt lib. we can A/B test placement. jorge: one more nit — color contrast for the token badge in dark mode. current purple value at 3.5:1. Need 4.5:1 for small text. michelle: noted. prioritize contrast fix + aria-labels. also decision: for compact default we do inline icon cluster but keep persistent footer for widescreen. will A/B test mobile footer vs inline. figma-bot: New comment on frame "Playground/Stream v4": https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/playground-stream-v4 — see comments 3,5,7. michelle: next steps: alex to update mocks with inline icon-only token counter + hover reveal, jorge to run contrast pass, katie to write ARIA spec and keyboard flow, sam to add telemetry events for control usage, i'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to pick A/B targets. thanks all! :tada:
